clue.text: Socrates's killer shows a hesitation to bolt

parts.note: hem, as in 'hem and haw', is a hesitant noise
to bolt a door is to lock it

explanation.surface: A hesitant moment lets the poison take hold of the Greek philosopher.
explanation.definitionFit: Socrates was condemned to death by drinking a poison brewed from this plant.

clue.text: Rabble-rousing lacks its initial impression

indicators.note: the first letter of the word for rabble-rousing is dropped

parts.note: sedition is incitement against authority

explanation.surface: Stirring up the mob fails to make a first impact.
explanation.definitionFit: A print run of a book is called an impression.

clue.text: Enjoyed song about monarch

indicators.note: the song goes round the monarch

parts.note: a Lied is a German art song
K is short for king

explanation.surface: Someone appreciated a ballad about a king.
explanation.definitionFit: Found pleasing, took pleasure in.

clue.text: Admit new church is bound by regulations

indicators.note: new church is held within the regulations, enclosed

parts.note: a code is a body of rules
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Confess that a new congregation is constrained by rules.
explanation.definitionFit: To acknowledge something as true, often reluctantly.

clue.text: Manage venture for widow

parts.note: to do is to manage or cope
a wager is a bet, a venture of money

explanation.surface: Someone is advised to handle a speculative investment on behalf of a bereaved woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A titled widow holding property or a title from her late husband is a classic example.

clue.text: Duck doctor in spring

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nought, O
to rig is to tamper with or doctor

explanation.surface: A bird gets treated by a vet in springtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spring' looks like the season; it is a source, as in 'wellspring'.
explanation.definitionFit: A source or fountainhead from which something springs.

clue.text: Battle for a drink on playing area

indicators.note: in a down clue, the drink sits above the playing area

parts.note: gin is a spirit
a court is where tennis is played

explanation.surface: Fighting over a glass of spirits on the tennis court.
explanation.definitionFit: Henry V defeated the French at this 1415 encounter.

clue.text: Bird slow to to imitate

parts.note: the emu is a flightless Australian bird
a slow clock is late, behind time

explanation.surface: A sluggish bird tries to copy another.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed 'to to' is a typo; one 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To copy someone in the hope of matching them.

clue.text: Opening quietly paper of a kind that gives the betting

parts.note: starting means opening, beginning
p is piano, music's quiet direction
rice paper is a thin edible paper

explanation.surface: A low-key opening of a newspaper's racing page.
explanation.definitionFit: These are the odds on a racehorse as the race begins, the final bookmaking figure.

clue.text: Instant credit

definitions.meaning: a moment, as in 'just a second'
informal British term for buying on account, 'on the slate'

explanation.surface: Like an advert for loans approved on the spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are informal British: a brief moment, and goods bought on account to pay later.

clue.text: Teachers' recipe? It promises to be wholesome!

parts.note: the NUT was the National Union of Teachers, a British trade union
R is short for recipe, the Latin 'take' heading prescriptions
IOUs are written promises to repay debts

explanation.surface: A teachers' union dish is advertised as healthy fare.
explanation.walkthrough: The NUT was a British teachers' trade union; R, for the Latin 'recipe', heads old prescriptions.
explanation.definitionFit: Food that nourishes the body is healthy and good for you.

clue.text: Arouse and race the French

parts.note: a kind is a sort, a race or breed
le is the French masculine for 'the'

explanation.surface: Stirring up rivalry with a race against the French.
explanation.definitionFit: To kindle feelings is to stir them up or set them alight.

clue.text: Scoundrel acquires a popular firm making clothing

indicators.note: the scoundrel takes the other pieces into himself, so they sit inside him

parts.note: a rat is a betrayer or rotter
in means fashionable or popular
Co is the abbreviation for company

explanation.surface: A crook buys up a fashionable business that makes garments.
explanation.definitionFit: A waterproof coat is one item of outerwear, so a specific example of clothing.

clue.text: Medication sorted out Gail's acne

indicators.note: the letters are arranged into a fresh order, as one sorts things out

explanation.surface: A woman named Gail takes a remedy that cleared up her spots.
explanation.definitionFit: A painkiller is a type of drug or medicine.

clue.text: Ancestral building — a royal house

indicators.note: the letters are built into a new structure

explanation.surface: An old family's stately home belongs to the monarchy.
explanation.definitionFit: The English dynasty of Henry IV to VI, with the red rose as badge.

clue.text: Regret drinking port with royal head of state

indicators.note: one word swallows the other, so it goes inside

parts.note: to rue is to regret
port is the left side of a ship, L
R stands for royal, as in RN

explanation.surface: A king regrets a bout of port drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch or president governs a country, leading it as sovereign.

clue.text: Little or no time to follow screening

indicators.note: the time abbreviation comes after the screening word

parts.note: a scan is a medical screening

explanation.surface: There's hardly any waiting before the medical screening.
explanation.definitionFit: Barely sufficient, meagre, describing a tiny amount.

clue.text: Fit in with artist's wild fantasy

parts.note: to chime with is to harmonise or agree
RA is a Royal Academician

explanation.surface: A painter's flight of fancy matches the mood.
explanation.definitionFit: A fanciful dream or illusion, named after a mythical monster.

clue.text: Rose's inelegant disposition

indicators.note: a disposition is an arrangement, so the letters are laid out anew

explanation.surface: A woman called Rose has a clumsy temperament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rose' looks like a name and 'disposition' a temperament; really it is a flower and an arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweet briar is a wild species of this flower.

clue.text: Warn parish priest getting into a lift

indicators.note: the priest enters the other pieces, so it goes inside

parts.note: a rise is an increase or lift

explanation.surface: Alert the vicar stepping into an elevator.
explanation.definitionFit: To inform or notify, so to put someone on notice.

clue.text: Ran over judge? Tell us the story!

indicators.note: in a down clue the word is turned over, read backwards

parts.note: to rate is to assess or judge

explanation.surface: A child asks for a tale of a runaway car hitting a magistrate.
explanation.definitionFit: To recount events in sequence, as a storyteller does.

clue.text: Character with inclination for one toiletry containing iodine

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: the powder holds the element inside

parts.note: talc is talcum powder
I is the chemical symbol for iodine

explanation.surface: A person who favours one bathroom product with a medicinal additive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Character' looks like a person; it is a printed letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A sloping typeface letter leans to the right.

clue.text: Persist in support for architectural feature

indicators.note: persisting is placed within the support

parts.note: a pier is a pillar supporting a bridge
to last is to persist or endure

explanation.surface: Keep backing a feature of a building.
explanation.definitionFit: A shallow rectangular column projecting from a wall is a classical design element.

clue.text: Mate's attempt to be sorry

parts.note: a mate is a pal, a friend
a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: A friend's effort to apologise.
explanation.definitionFit: 'Sorry' in the sense of pitiful or wretched, a meagre, poor thing.

clue.text: Permissible but to some extent duplicitous

indicators.note: only part of the word is used, the letters sitting within it

explanation.surface: Allowed, though a little two-faced.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: something lawful or sanctioned is allowed, the opposite of illicit.

clue.text: Film director developed erotic club

indicators.note: as film is developed, the letters are processed into a new form

explanation.surface: A filmmaker built up a racy nightclub.
explanation.definitionFit: Bernardo of that surname directed Last Tango in Paris and The Last Emperor.

clue.text: Talk about item of clothing

parts.note: c, for circa, means about
a hat is something worn

explanation.surface: A conversation about a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal conversation, a natter.

clue.text: Soldiers to pursue struggle for survival

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery
to trace is to follow a trail

explanation.surface: Troops chase down an enemy in a fight to stay alive.
explanation.definitionFit: The competitive daily grind of modern work life is a fight to get ahead.

clue.text: Hide drug among the soapsuds

indicators.note: the drug is set amid the suds

parts.note: lather is foamy soap
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Someone conceals narcotics in the bath foam.
explanation.definitionFit: Tanned animal skin is called hide.
